sayWin: [d92] 🌙 Night. The lingering The Suburb gorges at the treeline — 0 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
[d92] ⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.

[d92] ◈ "UNIT BEAT-UP PAPERBACK — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn (morale). You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

[d92] ◈ FLASHBACK — Beat-up Paperback
A field guide to edible plants, ironically. Spine cracked at the mushroom chapter — you were always going to learn mushrooms, someday. Someday is now.
[d92] 📖 The memory leaves something behind: Jewelweed — the orange touch-me-not by creeks. Poison ivy’s antidote. The book taught you.
[d92] 💛 The Beat-up Paperback is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — quiet luck: 1 in 5 misses lands anyway, while worn.)
[d92] No food in the pantry. The village is hungry. You still get your 1L water.
[d92] Manuela is showing Colton how to tie a snare. Hands patient. It takes three tries.
[d92] 🔍 Ruth has been turning over a thorny acacia; amber gum oozing from bark wounds for days — today it clicked. "I know this one now. Look — see the leaves?"
[d92] Ruth traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
[d92] Devon went to sleep hungry. Nobody says anything.

[d93] Ruth is showing everyone Gum Acacia by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
[d93] Colton: "Walked past a good stand of blackberry. Worth remembering where."
[d93] 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Colton is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
[d93] Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
[d93] 📖 The entry for Colton is finished. No more pages.
[d93] COLTON — GONE. 6 open questions closed unanswered.
[d93] 💀 Colton starved. Slowly. The village is 3 now.

[d93] 🌿 Ground Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
[d93] 💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
[d94] 🎣 Devon worked the creek — 3 fish, +315 kcal to the pantry.
[d94] 💧 Ruth returns with water: +3 clean.
[d94] That night, they bring Olivia home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
[d94] Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
[d94] ⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
[d94] Village meal: +665 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
[d94] Ruth set out an extra bowl before catching themself. Nobody mentioned it.
[d94] Ruth is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 72/100)

[d94] ◈ CRISIS — THE HUNGER WINTER. Three days now the village has gone to sleep hungry. The pantry is an echo. This is the part the old stories skip — the part where you find out what you’re made of.
[d94] SYSTEM: "Organic units require fuel. Noting. Noting loudly. The audience is very quiet, which for them is screaming."
[d94] ⚠ Haven's pantry is empty. Day 3 of hunger.
[d94] Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.
